description: Bare canvas layout. Optional centering. Use for onboarding, blank states, full-page loading.

content.description: Canvas slot. Pass ComponentConfig JSON for data-driven rendering OR a custom ReactNode for full control.

slot_types.ComponentSlot: ComponentConfig JSON (data-driven, registry lookup) OR ReactNode (custom JSX, rendered directly). JSON takes priority.

note: children prop also accepted as backward-compat alias for content.
